common.failed: The change could not be completed. Please try again.

jobs.failedHint: Check that the files are accessible and enough storage space is available.
jobs.otherRunning: Another audio task is running. Wait for it to finish.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.empty: No plays in this period yet
statistics.emptyHint: Statistics record listening from now on. Earlier plays cannot be reconstructed.
statistics.recordHint: Stores listening history on this device only. Turning this off keeps existing data.
statistics.disabled: Recording is turned off. Existing statistics remain available.
statistics.thresholdTitle: When does a song count as heard?
statistics.thresholdHint: A playback pass counts when either value is reached. Pauses and skipped audio do not count as listening time.
statistics.recalculateHint: Changed thresholds also apply to previously recorded playback passes.
statistics.clearHint: All recorded plays and listening times will be permanently deleted for every period. Songs, favorites and playlists are kept.

equalizer.title: Equalizer
equalizer.description: Adjust bass, midrange and treble. Your custom setting is saved.
equalizer.headroomHint: Boosting a frequency band lowers the preamp when needed to help prevent clipping.
equalizer.clipping: This preamp setting may clip when combined with the boosted frequencies.

sleep.title: Sleep timer
sleep.description: Pauses playback after the chosen duration or at the chosen ending.
sleep.afterQueue: At the end of this queue
sleep.queueHint: The timer applies across the app and stays active when you switch queues. Song and queue endings refer to the currently active playback.

editor.title: Trim audio
editor.description: Choose the section to keep or remove. Export creates a new file and keeps the original.
editor.waveformLabel: Waveform. Selection from {{start}} to {{end}}. Adjust the boundaries below using the keyboard.
editor.waveformUnavailable: The waveform could not be loaded. You can set the selection using the time fields.
editor.noDuration: The duration of this song is unavailable. It cannot be trimmed yet.
editor.previewHint: Preview is limited to 90 seconds and pauses normal playback. You can resume normal playback with Play afterward.
editor.previewFailed: The preview could not be played. Check that the source file is accessible.
editor.exportFailed: The copy could not be exported. Choose a destination other than the original file and check the available storage.

loudness.title: Match loudness between songs
loudness.description: Balances different recordings with a fixed level adjustment per song. Quiet and loud passages within a song keep their relative difference.
loudness.missingHint: Uses existing ReplayGain tags or values calculated in the app. Songs without values remain unchanged.

groupHints.track: Each song is adjusted to a comparable level.
groupHints.album: Songs from an album share one adjustment. Intentionally quieter songs stay quieter. Analysis includes other known songs from the same album.
groupHints.folder: Songs in the same folder share one adjustment. Their relative loudness is preserved. Analysis includes other known songs from the same folder.

loudness.dynamics: Dynamically balance quiet and loud passages
loudness.dynamicsHint: Changes the level during a song. Useful for quiet listening; also changes the original dynamics.
loudness.calculatedCount: Calculated in the app for this grouping: {{calculated}} of {{total}} selected songs.
loudness.unsupportedTags: At least one file does not support writing ReplayGain tags. Turn off writing to files and store the values in the app instead.
loudness.writeTags: Also write ReplayGain tags into the files
loudness.writeTagsHint: Changes the original files’ metadata so other players can use the values. Supports FLAC, MP3, Ogg Vorbis and M4A.
loudness.folderTagsHint: Folder values are stored in the app only. There are no standardized ReplayGain tags for folders.
loudness.localHint: Calculated values are stored in the app. Original files remain unchanged.
loudness.failed: Analysis could not be started. Check the source files and whether another audio task is running.

library.title: Externally opened files
library.description: View and folder suggestions when opening an audio file.
library.openExternalNowPlaying: Show opened audio files in Now Playing
library.openExternalNowPlayingHint: Opens the expanded playback view when you double-click a file.
library.suggestExternalFoldersHint: Briefly shows a notice when the folder is not part of the library yet.

globalSearch.title: Quick search outside the app
globalSearch.description: Opens quick search from other programs while Song Player is running, including in the tray.
globalSearch.bindingHint: Click the shortcut and press the combination you want. Ctrl + F remains available for searching inside other programs.
globalSearch.invalidBinding: Use a combination with Ctrl or Alt. Ctrl + F and reserved system shortcuts are unavailable.
globalSearch.conflict: The shortcut could not be activated. It may already be in use or unavailable on this system.
globalSearch.learningHint: Quick search learns locally which results you choose frequently.
